mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the sensory and motor routes was most worthwhile: the pictures showed where the cell bodies stay and how signals travel into and out of the cord.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the four central regions felt repetitive after the first couple, even though their pictures showed different jobs.

surprise.text: I was surprised that one spinal nerve carries incoming and outgoing signals on different axons, which use separate roots at the cord.

arbitrary.text: The repeated neural-tissue pairings were guided by the cutaway openings, but I was mostly following the same pattern rather than understanding every named region beforehand.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because the unfinished connections to upper-limb tissues make me curious how the nerves will connect to structures built earlier.
